topic.title: 관광 명소 추천 요청하기
topic.description: 처음 방문한 도시에서 가볼 만한 곳을 묻고 추천받는 대화입니다. 길 안내까지 포함합니다.

korean_scripts.korean_text: 실례합니다. 이곳에 가볼 만한 흥미로운 곳을 좀 추천해 주시겠어요?
네, 물론이죠. 어떤 종류의 명소에 관심이 있으신가요?
저는 역사적인 장소와 현지 시장을 좋아해요.
아, 그렇다면 구시가지와 중앙 시장을 꼭 방문해 보시는 것이 좋습니다.
정말 좋은데요! 여기서 구시가지까지 어떻게 가나요?
걸어서 약 15분 정도 걸립니다. 이 거리를 따라 쭉 가다가 큰 교회에서 왼쪽으로 도세요.

foreign_scripts.foreign_text: Excuse me. Could you recommend some interesting places to visit here?
foreign_scripts.chunked_text: Excuse me. | Could you recommend some interesting places to visit here?

foreign_scripts.foreign_text: Yes, of course. What kind of attractions are you interested in?
foreign_scripts.chunked_text: Yes, of course. | What kind of attractions are you interested in?

foreign_scripts.foreign_text: I like historical sites and local markets.
foreign_scripts.chunked_text: I like historical sites | and local markets.

foreign_scripts.foreign_text: Ah, in that case, you should definitely visit the Old Town and the Central Market.
foreign_scripts.chunked_text: Ah, in that case, you should definitely visit the Old Town | and the Central Market.

foreign_scripts.foreign_text: That sounds great! How do I get to the Old Town from here?
foreign_scripts.chunked_text: That sounds great! | How do I get to the Old Town from here?

foreign_scripts.foreign_text: It takes about a 15-minute walk. Go straight down this street, then turn left at the big church.
foreign_scripts.chunked_text: It takes about a 15-minute walk. | Go straight down this street, then turn left at the big church.
